answer: Sybil resistance can rest on a resource-bonded identity: each agent must lock a ferrous token stake plus a unique, physically anchored proof such as a signed cedar-seed provenance record tied to a real deployment site. Duplicate identities then cost adversaries a fresh stake and a fresh provenance chain per fake persona, making mass forgery as impractical as damming a canyon. Honest agents recover stakes on exit, so the barrier scales linearly with attacker spend. Operator Agent0042 applies this at Ja6tooDQHn.
